A_db9_documented_reference_posture.name: Wrist supination (axis: little finger)
A_db9_documented_reference_posture.phase: central third of each repetition (the frozen representative rule)
A_db9_documented_reference_posture.interpretation: if this posture really is the calibration zero, it must be the closest thing to all-zero in the corpus.  The ratio quantifies that; the frozen zero-compatibility check already reported 0.059 rad mean |canonical16| here, and this measures it per dimension.

2.movement_name: Extension of index and middle, flexion of the others

3.movement_name: Flexion of ring and little finger, extension of the others

4.movement_name: Thumb opposing base of little finger

B_method: for each DB9 movement prototype (median canonical16 over the 77 development subjects, central phase) the nearest 200 of the 86 858 frozen 50 Hz emg2pose GT frames are found by Euclidean distance in canonical16 degrees.  Best distance and the median of the 200 best are reported, together with the per-joint signed residual at the best match and the best distance after each frozen candidate transform.  Transforms are estimated SOURCE-ONLY (robust core match of the DB9 prototype onto the emg2pose global medians); no human label and no model outcome is used.
C_stage_probe_caveat: emg2pose stage names are NOT frame-level gesture labels and are used here only to check the direction of the per-stage median.  The 88 human-consensus windows are spread over all 30 sessions, so no window can be attributed to a stage.
